name: web-auth/cose-lib
description: CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) For PHP

suggest.ext-bcmath: Recommended: without GMP or BCMath, signing with RSASSA-PSS (PS256/PS384/PS512) blinds its private exponentiation in pure PHP
suggest.ext-gmp: Recommended: without GMP or BCMath, signing with RSASSA-PSS (PS256/PS384/PS512) blinds its private exponentiation in pure PHP
suggest.ext-sodium: Required by the EdDSA/Ed25519 signature algorithms (-8, -19, -260, -261) and to recompute an OKP public key from its private key
